title: AWS global infrastructure (regions, zones, edge)
summary: Understand how Amazon Web Services (AWS) partitions the planet into Regions, Availability Zones, Local Zones, Wavelength, and edge locations. Learn data residency, physical isolation, latency tradeoffs, and how Route 53 and CloudFront fit into global traffic routing for highly available workloads.

topics.title: Regions: isolation, compliance, and data residency
Availability Zones: physical isolation within a Region
Edge locations and Regional Edge Caches
Local Zones and Wavelength (ultra-low latency extensions)
How to choose a Region and Availability Zone for high availability
Global traffic routing overview (Route 53 and CloudFront)
